subject: general
question: NCSM is an autonomous organization under Ministry of culture. What is the full form of NCSM?
solution:
The correct answer is__** National Council of Science Museums.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• National Council of Science Museums (NCSM) is an autonomous organization and It is an autonomous organization under the Indian Ministry of Culture.
 
• It is the largest chain of science centers or museums under a single administrative umbrella in the world.
 
• the first science museum, Birla Industrial and Technological Museum (BITM), Kolkata under CSIR, was opened on May 2, 1959.
 
• the NCSM has been built to coordinate all informal science communication activities in the museum space in the country.
 
• In July 1965 the second science museum, Visvesvaraya Industrial & Technological Museum (VITM) was opened in Bangalore.
 
• After Kolkata and Bangalore, the work for the third center in Mumbai was taken up in 1974.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** Folk Art Museum, Patna

 
• Founded in 1963, the museum displays age-old artifacts including folk instruments and jewelry.
 
• The museum is also known for its huge collection of terracotta and ceramic objects.

Madhya Pradesh Tribal Museum, Bhopal

 
• This is one of the most excellent and different sorts of museums.
 
• It presents the lifestyle and culture of tribal people.

Albert Hall Museum, Jaipur

 
• Albert Hall Museum, Jaipur is the oldest museum in the state and is considered an incredible piece of Indo-Saracenic architecture.
 
• The museum was designed by Samuel Swinton Jacob and the museum was open to the public since 1887.
